schema.name: price_basis

shelf-stable-pantry-per-dollar-2026.description: Twenty-seven shelf-stable pantry foods ranked by protein grams per dollar, covering canned, dried and jarred items that need no refrigeration.
shelf-stable-pantry-per-dollar-2026.long_description: 27 shelf-stable pantry foods ranked by grams of protein per US dollar. Nothing in this dataset needs refrigeration, so it doubles as a stock-up list.

schema.name: food
schema.description: Food item as sold at retail, including the form (dry, canned, frozen, bone-in) where the form changes the math.

schema.name: value
schema.description: Grams of protein per US dollar spent, after the edible fraction is applied.

schema.name: package
schema.description: Package size the recorded price refers to, as sold on the shelf.

schema.name: package_price_usd
schema.description: Shelf price in US dollars for that package.

schema.name: price_basis
schema.description: Source and observation date for the price, plus any USDA refuse percentage applied.
